arguments.content:
#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The destination can be supplied as BACKUP_DEST or as the first argument.
DEST="${BACKUP_DEST:-${DEST:-}}"
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
    DEST="$1"
fi

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: backup destination is not set (set BACKUP_DEST or pass it as an argument)" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

# Copy to a local mount with cp, or to host:path with scp.
case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
    *)
        cp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE"

arguments.command:
set -eu
rm -rf /tmp/backup-test
mkdir -p /tmp/backup-test
./backup.sh /tmp/backup-test
ls -la /tmp/backup-test
test -f /tmp/backup-test/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz && echo 'arg copy OK'
BACKUP_DEST=/tmp/backup-test ./backup.sh
echo 'env copy OK'
set +e
./backup.sh >/tmp/backup-test/no-dest.out 2>/tmp/backup-test/no-dest.err
code=$?
set -e
echo "no-dest exit=$code"
cat /tmp/backup-test/no-dest.err
if [ "$code" -eq 0 ]; then echo 'expected non-zero'; exit 1; fi
